_meta.description: ADR-037 register fragment declaring the Titel 9 Boek 2 BW jaarrekening (annual financial statement) data model: AnnualReport, BalanceSheet, IncomeStatement, CashFlowStatement, Note, DirectorReport and ReviewWorkflow. Schema-declared per ADR-031 (lifecycle/RBAC/relations as metadata, no parallel service classes per ADR-022). The exact rubriek codes per art. 2:373 & 2:377 BW are stored as data; GL-to-rubriek mapping is configuration (lib/Settings/seeds/).

AnnualReport.title: Annual Report
AnnualReport.description: Titel 9 Boek 2 BW jaarrekening root record for one administration and one boekjaar (REQ-T9-001, REQ-T9-010). Carries the computed groottecategorie with its onderbouwing, the rapportagegrondslag, valuta, and the concept -> opgemaakt -> in-review -> vastgesteld -> gedeponeerd lifecycle with its wettelijke termijnen. The constituent documents (BalanceSheet, IncomeStatement, CashFlowStatement, Note, DirectorReport) reference this record by reportId. Groottecategorie is computed, not operator-selectable (design D1); the report becomes an immutable snapshot at opmaak (design D2). No AnnualReportService PHP class; generation is templated per ADR-022/ADR-031.

concept.label: Concept
concept.description: Earliest form; balans/V&W recalculate as the GL changes (REQ-T9-010). Editable.

opgemaakt.label: Opgemaakt door bestuur
opgemaakt.description: Bestuur-signed; an immutable snapshot is taken and all figures freeze (design D2).

in-review.label: In review (accountant)
in-review.description: Under accountant review. Bestuur source data is read-only until the review is cancelled (REQ-T9-007).

vastgesteld.label: Vastgesteld door AV
vastgesteld.description: Approved by the algemene vergadering; final snapshot frozen; deponering activated (REQ-T9-010).

gedeponeerd.label: Gedeponeerd bij KVK
gedeponeerd.description: Filed at KVK via SBR-XBRL; immutable final state (REQ-T9-008).

opmaken.label: Opmaken door bestuur
opmaken.description: Bestuur signs the concept; an immutable snapshot is created (REQ-T9-010, design D2). Requires the balans to balance (activa = passiva).

naarReview.label: Indienen voor accountantscontrole
naarReview.description: Submit the opgemaakte jaarrekening to the accountant. Bestuur source data becomes read-only (REQ-T9-007).

reviewAnnuleren.label: Review annuleren
reviewAnnuleren.description: Cancel the review to re-open bestuur editing (REQ-T9-007). The accountant change-log is retained.

vaststellenZonderReview.label: Vaststellen door AV
vaststellenZonderReview.description: AV approves directly where no accountantsverklaring is verplicht (klein/micro; REQ-T9-007/REQ-T9-009). OUTCOME-DRIVEN per REQ-SIGN-003: requires adoption decisionOutcome==approved from decidesk.

vaststellen.label: Vaststellen na review
vaststellen.description: AV approves after accountant sign-off; an accountantsverklaring MUST be attached for middelgroot+ (REQ-T9-007/REQ-T9-010). OUTCOME-DRIVEN per REQ-SIGN-003: requires adoption decisionOutcome==approved from decidesk.

deponeren.label: Deponeren bij KVK
deponeren.description: Hand the final AnnualReport snapshot to bookkeeping-sbr-xbrl-reporting for SBR-XBRL conversion and Digipoort submission (REQ-T9-008).

actions.description: Emit a CloudEvent consumed by bookkeeping-sbr-xbrl-reporting to convert the snapshot to SBR-XBRL and submit via Digipoort (REQ-T9-008). Cross-module integration point; no PHP orchestration here (ADR-022).

BalanceSheet.title: Balance Sheet
BalanceSheet.description: Balans conforming to art. 2:373 BW (REQ-T9-002). Activa split into vaste activa (B.I immaterieel, B.II materieel, B.III financieel) and vlottende activa (C.I voorraden, C.II vorderingen, C.III effecten, C.IV liquide middelen); passiva split into A eigen vermogen, B voorzieningen, C langlopende schulden, D kortlopende schulden. Each rubriek carries huidigJaar, vorigJaar (comparatief) and footnote references. GL-to-rubriek mapping is configuration (lib/Settings/seeds/balans-rubriek-mapping.json), not code (design D3).

totalActiva.description: Computed total assets. MUST equal totalPassiva (balans balances).
totalActiva.title: Total Activa

totalPassiva.description: Computed total liabilities + equity. MUST equal totalActiva.
totalPassiva.title: Total Passiva

IncomeStatement.title: Income Statement
IncomeStatement.description: Winst-en-verliesrekening per art. 2:377 BW (REQ-T9-003). Model A 'categorisch' groups costs by type; Model E 'functioneel' groups costs by function. Model choice must be consistent year-on-year; a change is a stelselwijziging disclosure. Subtotals (bedrijfsresultaat, resultaat voor belasting, nettoresultaat) are computed. The model rubriek catalogue is configuration (lib/Settings/seeds/vw-model-rubrieken.json), not code.

CashFlowStatement.title: Cash Flow Statement
CashFlowStatement.description: Kasstroomoverzicht per RJ 350 (REQ-T9-005). Mandatory only for middelgroot+; klein/micro may prepare voluntarily. Indirect method is default (nettoresultaat + afschrijvingen + mutaties werkkapitaal); direct method optional. Three categories (operationeel, investering, financiering) reconcile to the change in liquide middelen on the balans.

Note.title: Toelichting Note
Note.description: An individual toelichting-paragraaf (accounting note) per art. 2:381-388 BW and the RJ guidelines (REQ-T9-004). Each note carries its volgorde, code, titel, structured content, the wettelijke basis (RJ guideline / wetsartikel) and the template that generated it. Mandatory notes per groottecategorie come from lib/Settings/seeds/toelichting-templates.json (design D4).

code.title: Code

contentJSONB.title: Content Jsonb

DirectorReport.title: Director Report
DirectorReport.description: Bestuursverslag per art. 2:391 BW (REQ-T9-006), mandatory for middelgroot+. A separate entity from AnnualReport (design D8) so it can be versioned and signed independently. Sections (algemeen, financiële-gang, risico's, toekomst, personeel, milieu, optional r-d and esg) carry auto-populated context plus operator narrative.

name.title: Name

ReviewWorkflow.title: Review Workflow
ReviewWorkflow.description: Accountant-review workflow for a jaarrekening (REQ-T9-007). A strict linear progression (design D6): concept -> in-review -> vastgesteld -> gedeponeerd, with per-step assignee, status and an immutable comment/handover log. During in-review the bestuur cannot edit source data without cancelling (enforced via AnnualReportGuard). The accountantsverklaring attaches at the in-review -> vastgesteld boundary.
